producer_report.summary:
I extended docs/spec.toml to BRIEF sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the addenda of 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-24. `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` (22 tests, including `the_real_spec_passes`) and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` (12 tests) both pass. `cargo fmt --all --check` is clean. Clippy is clean on xtask only; I did not run it on the whole workspace.

- **Requirements:** about 55 new ones, ids `OLY-7-nn`, `OLY-8-nn`, `OLY-9-nn`, `OLY-10-nn`, `OLY-GP-nn` and `OLY-A-nn`. Each cites verbatim quotes under its heading. Where a brief line holds a word the boundary scan rejects (for example "handoffs"), the quote stops before it.
- **Open questions:** three, recorded and not resolved. In each, one side is a 2026-10-17 or 2026-10-18 rule and the other is Sri's 2026-10-23 "Don't involve me unless you have to". The earlier sides are the history-exemption rule (OQ-1), Sri approving each spec change (OQ-2) and delegation only in writing (OQ-3). I recorded none for trailers: only the 2026-10-23 addendum has trailer words inside the covered range, and earlier trailer text is before Olympus, so the test cannot cite it. No requirement is marked superseded.
- **Test (`xtask/tests/spec.rs`):** the cut now stops at the first heading dated after 2026-10-24, so 2026-10-25 and later cannot be cited. Coverage now also requires a requirement under sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and every addendum heading in range.
- **New negative cases:** a non-verbatim quote under a section 7+ heading, a missing section 8, a missing philosophy or addendum requirement, a heading dated 2026-10-25 and an ambiguous heading start.
- **Heading form:** the "2026-10-17: The operator is the brain for now" heading holds a word the scan rejects, so a spec source may now cite a heading start ending in "…" (`2026-10-17: The…`). The start must match exactly one heading.
- **Existing text:** I edited two header comment lines in spec.toml that said sections 1 to 6 hold no open questions and that the second layer would follow. No existing entry changed.
- **Logs:** docs/decisions.md has a new D144, and CHANGELOG.md has an Added line under Unreleased.

open_issues: No in-range conflict between the 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-24 addenda and earlier trailer text was recorded, because that earlier text is outside the Olympus-onward text the test can cite.
The "…" heading-start form is new to the checker. It is used once, for 2026-10-17: The… (the heading holds a word the scan rejects).
The coverage test is still named ...sections_1_to_5 (docs/enforcement.md cites that name) although coverage now spans more.
mistakes: I first renamed the coverage test, and policy.rs failed because docs/enforcement.md names it. I restored the name.
I first reused the id OQ-1 in the open_question_sides test, which collided with the real OQ-1. I changed it to OQ-TEST.
learnings: The boundary scan reads docs/spec.toml, and BRIEF.md uses banned words in some headings and quotes (the 2026-10-17 operator heading, handoff, sandbox). Spec quotes must stop before them, and that heading needs the new "…" start-of-heading form.
docs/enforcement.md cites test names from xtask/tests/spec.rs, so renaming a test breaks policy.rs.
sections() used to leave `number` at 10 for the `## Governing philosophy` and `## Addenda` headings. It is now cleared for non-numbered `##` headings.
